findings.citation: Any other stage value must be refused by throwing `TemplateMismatchError` (the existing exported class, or a subclass of it).
findings.description: The oracle formats the invalid value with JSON.stringify before constructing TemplateMismatchError. JSON.stringify(1n) and JSON.stringify(circularObject) throw TypeError, so those invalid primitive/object stages are not refused with the required error class.

findings.citation: Any other stage value must be refused by throwing `TemplateMismatchError` (the existing exported class, or a subclass of it).
findings.description: The checks cover numbers, booleans, NaN, ordinary objects, arrays, and boxed strings, but not bigint or circular objects; consequently they do not detect the oracle's non-TemplateMismatchError failures for those required values.

findings.citation: One entry per distinct defect, each with a non-empty `location` and `defect`.
findings.description: The findings checks validate category presence and field non-emptiness but never assert the returned count, so duplicate ledger entries for the same defect are accepted.

publicationScope: Admission judgments and native outcome metadata only; prompts, raw streams, HTTP bodies, configuration and credential state excluded.
